messages:
Ashley J: Quick handoff note — AcmePay scheduled load run tomorrow 2026-04-01 02:00-02:30 PDT (UTC-7). Customer expects ~3x normal QPS during that window. This is a VIP account with p95 SLA 200ms. Risk: can hit burst limit and trigger fallback to smaller model, which increases latency. I won't be on from 03:30 PDT, need cover from 01:30-04:00 PDT. Can someone cover the watch + be ready to scale dedicated pool?

Jordan M: I can cover 01:30-03:30 PDT. What's the plan to scale? Any runbook link?

Ashley J: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acmepay-loadrun. TL;DR: autoscale only to pool cap 40 GPUs by default. For emergency manual bump run: `rdctl capacity set --pool acmepay-prod --gpus 80` — needs infra-sre permission. Also if latency spikes >250ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, enable degraded routing: `/redwood routing set --policy degraded-vip --target small-model` (ops only). Bookmark both.

Kevin R: Quick smoke checks to run at start of spike?

Ashley J: 1) `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"acme-v2","prompt":"healthcheck"}'` — expect <150ms p50. 2) Watch per-route token counts in console. 3) Check KV cache hit rate > 60% (if drop, latency rises).

Samira: I can take 03:30-05:00 PDT if Jordan can hand off at 03:20. Need handoff steps — also we should pause the model canary scheduled at 01:15 PDT (model acme-7.2) — that could add extra churn.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] canary rollout acme-7.2 planned for 2026-04-01 01:15 PDT by @ml-release

Ashley J: Yes please pause that canary. Command to pause: ```sh
rdctl rollout pause --canary acme-7-2
``` I emailed @infra-sre to approve capacity bump if needed.

Jordan M: Ack. I'll pause canary at 01:10 PDT and start watch at 01:30 PDT. Samira — I'll DM you the live checks before handoff.

Kevin R: If we need to scale but infra-sre is slow, fallback is to temporarily disable large-model routing for AcmePay: `rdctl routing set acmepay --variant small-model` — this will keep throughput but raises error rates for a small subset. Use only if latency >350ms and infra not responding.

Samira: Got it. Also flagging contract SLA: if p95 > 300ms for >10m we need to open an incident for exec notif. Keep logs of spikes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Pager window for @oncall starts 2026-04-01 01:00 PDT for this thread.

Ashley J: Thanks all — leaving notes in runbook section "active-watch-2026-04-01". Please post a final short closure message after the run.

Jordan M: Will do. :thumbsup:

Samira: I'll post closure and attach the perf graphs. :white_check_mark:

Kevin R: Available on call if needed.
